Five Arrested in Separate Land Deal Fraud Cases Totaling ₹8 Crore

Police in Pune and Navi Mumbai have arrested five individuals in connection with two separate land deal fraud cases. In Pune, a businessman was allegedly cheated out of ₹5.7 crore through an illegal land sale. In Navi Mumbai, a builder was defrauded of ₹2.3 crore in a land transaction. The arrests were made in connection with these specific incidents.
